workflow_runs.name: DCO Check
workflow_runs.display_title: Add abi3 wheel support via the stable ABI

head_commit.message:
Add abi3 wheel support via the stable ABI

Build the CPython extension against the stable ABI (Py_LIMITED_API=0x030B0000)
so that one cp311-abi3 wheel covers Python 3.11 and every later version,
instead of shipping a wheel per Python version.

Two things the limited API does not expose had to change:

* reader.c defines the Reader type with PyType_FromSpec instead of a static
  PyTypeObject, and fetches tp_free via PyType_GetSlot.
* pack.c replaces PyMemoryView_GET_BUFFER (from cpython/memoryobject.h) with
  PyObject_GetBuffer. As a side effect a non-contiguous memoryview now raises
  BufferError instead of silently packing the wrong bytes.

Python.h no longer pulls in <string.h> under the limited API, so reader.c and
pack.c include it explicitly.

PyPy and free-threaded CPython keep building against their own ABI: PyPy does
not consume abi3 wheels, and setuptools rejects py_limited_api together with
Py_GIL_DISABLED.

Signed-off-by: trim21 <i@trim21.me>
